generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Work done certificate of the maximum value of civil engineering work executed in any one year during last 5 years. Which should be counter sign by the Executive Engineer or Equivalent in charge of the work

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer shall furnish last five years Amount Rs.41.52Lakhs financial turnover, profit and loss account statement i.e., from 2021-22, 2023-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 from the authorized Auditor or C.A. (Achieved in at least two financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) (usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this contract)) With UDIN
Contractors should be registered as KPWD Class III & above Civil Contractor
Assessed Tender Capacity shall be more than the Tendered Amount Rs.41.52 Lakhs

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (b) satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value) as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Improvements/Construction/Maintenance of Road work for Rs.20.76Lakhs

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual maintenance of Mandya Hadagali Road SH-47 from Ch 41.47 to 48.37Km for the year 2026-27 in Nagamangala taluk

itemList.description: Clearing  &  grubbing  road  land  including  vegetation,  bushes, shrubs, saplings by using weed cutter / minor equipment. ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Prime Coat over WMM/WBM - Providing  and  applying  primer  coat  with  SS1  grade  Bitumen Emulsion   on   prepared   surface   of   granular   base   including cleaning of road surface and spraying primer at the rate of 0.70 kg/m2  using mechanical means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 502 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Bituminous Macadam Grading - II for traffic <20 MSA - Providing  and  laying  Bituminous  Macadam  with  40/60  TPH capacity    hot  mix  plant  using  crushed  aggregates  of  specified grading  premixed  with  bituminous  binder  VG-30  @  3.4%  by weight of mix, transported to site, laid over a previously prepared surface  with  mechanical  paver  finisher  to  the  required  grade, level and alignment and rolled as per clauses 501.6 and 501.7 to achieve the desired compaction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 504 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete - Providing  and  laying  Semi  Dense  Bituminous  Concrete  with 40/60  TPH  capacity   hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30  @  5%  by  weight  of  mix  and  filler,  transported  to  site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per MoRTH V revision. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC-37:2018 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Surface Drains in Soil - Construction  of    unlined  surface  drains  of  average  cross- sectional  area  0.40  m2  in  soil  to  specified  lines,  grades, levels  and  dimensions.  Excavated  material  to  be  used  in embankment with a lift upto 3m and lead of 50 m (average lead 25 m) as per Technical Specification Clause 307. - Mechanical Means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 307 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Granular Sub-Base - Plant Mix Method - Construction   of   Granular   Sub-Base   of   required   grading   as per  design  mixing  in  a  mechanical  mix  plant  at  OMC,  carriage of  mixed  Material  to  work  site,  spreading  in  uniform  layers with  motor  grader  on  prepared  surface  and  compacting  with vibratory power roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 - For Grading -III Material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 401 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Tack coat on Bituminous surface - Providing and applying tack coat with RS1 Bituminous Emulsion using emulsion pressure distributor at the rate of 0.20  kg/m2  on the prepared bituminous surface cleaned with mechanical broom. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 503 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work
